-- Insert demo courses for Spring 2026 (semesterId=1)
INSERT INTO courses (code, name, description, credits, department, level, scheduleDay, scheduleTime, room, capacity, semesterId, isActive)
VALUES
  ('CS101', 'Introduction to Computer Science', 'Fundamentals of programming, algorithms, and computational thinking. Covers Python basics, data structures, and problem-solving strategies.', 3, 'Computer Science', '100', 'Mon/Wed/Fri', '09:00-10:00', 'Room A101', 40, 1, true),
  ('CS201', 'Data Structures & Algorithms', 'In-depth study of arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, sorting, and searching algorithms. Prerequisites: CS101.', 3, 'Computer Science', '200', 'Tue/Thu', '10:00-11:30', 'Room A102', 35, 1, true),
  ('CS301', 'Database Systems', 'Relational database design, SQL, normalization, transactions, and NoSQL databases. Includes practical lab sessions.', 3, 'Computer Science', '300', 'Mon/Wed', '14:00-15:30', 'Room B201', 30, 1, true),
  ('CS401', 'Software Engineering', 'Software development lifecycle, agile methodologies, design patterns, testing, and project management.', 3, 'Computer Science', '400', 'Tue/Thu', '14:00-15:30', 'Room B202', 25, 1, true),
  ('MATH101', 'Calculus I', 'Limits, derivatives, integrals, and applications. Foundational course for STEM disciplines.', 4, 'Mathematics', '100', 'Mon/Wed/Fri', '08:00-09:00', 'Room C101', 50, 1, true),
  ('MATH201', 'Linear Algebra', 'Vectors, matrices, linear transformations, eigenvalues, and applications in data science.', 3, 'Mathematics', '200', 'Tue/Thu', '08:00-09:30', 'Room C102', 40, 1, true),
  ('PHYS101', 'Physics I: Mechanics', 'Classical mechanics, kinematics, dynamics, energy, and momentum. Includes weekly lab sessions.', 4, 'Physics', '100', 'Mon/Wed/Fri', '11:00-12:00', 'Room D101', 45, 1, true),
  ('ENG101', 'Academic Writing', 'Developing academic writing skills: argumentation, research, citation, and critical analysis.', 2, 'English', '100', 'Tue/Thu', '13:00-14:00', 'Room E101', 30, 1, true),
  ('BUS201', 'Principles of Management', 'Organizational behavior, leadership, strategic planning, and business ethics.', 3, 'Business', '200', 'Mon/Wed', '16:00-17:30', 'Room F201', 60, 1, true),
  ('CS501', 'Machine Learning', 'Supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, deep learning, and AI applications.', 3, 'Computer Science', '500', 'Wed/Fri', '15:00-16:30', 'Room B301', 20, 1, true)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name);
